subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should runtime plugin registry loading invalidate legacy no-code, no-pluginId diagnostics with missing absolute sources, or should that cleanup be limited to an explicit migration/doctor path?
rationale: The explicit new marker is narrowly tied to configured orphan source paths, but the legacy branch intentionally changes current upgrade behavior for older persisted diagnostics that cannot be distinguished by code.

options.title: Accept Runtime Legacy Re-Derive After Proof
options.body: Treat the legacy branch as acceptable startup recovery once visible legacy SQLite proof is added.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: Keep the explicit marker/schema fix but remove the legacy no-code runtime branch and repair old rows through doctor or migration-owned code.

recommendation.title: Accept Runtime Legacy Re-Derive After Proof
recommendation.body: Treat the legacy branch as acceptable startup recovery once visible legacy SQLite proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc gave the predecessor’s explicit-marker direction and has recent plugin registry/discovery ownership signals.
